fusions.name: Flatten and Go
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. You move 30% faster for 3 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Ground Leveller
fusions.desc: Brings the head down at a run, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wound-Up Swing
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 10 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Momentum Carries
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, your physical damage rises by 25% for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
